notes.passage: The publisher labels GIDSL as isolated dynamic recognition. Its abstract describes a dataset, MediaPipe feature extraction, and an LSTM/dense model, but does not establish sentence-level recognition. This does not substantiate the review's sentence-result claim.

The matching 2023 ACL title is authored by Li and colleagues, not Singh. The abstract describes classification of ASL alphabets and custom signs into text, rather than establishing continuous linguistic-sign recognition. Because the review gives different authors, the intended citation remains unresolved.

notes.passage: The PDF abstract and Table5 identify a single continuous/online study with multiple decoding settings. Reference [6] is Takayama et al. (10.5220/0010899400003124); [8] is Buttar et al. (10.3390/math11173729). The previously noted inconsistent study counts remain unresolved.

Takayama and colleagues evaluate skeleton-based online continuous word recognition using monotonic attention on isolated-word and sentence videos. The abstract confirms this study's CSLR task; it does not establish a second distinct study in the review.
